intent.raw: Start a Craft space inside Arcanum for a manual, then create a dispatch-spec research strategy that gathers all knowledge of Arcanum as input to /whisper, so we can author a manual that distills the knowledge, explains usage, and patterns the framework. The end goal is that a reader understands what Arcanum is, what its processes are, and how each kind of user can leverage it. Use /x-ray and development/user-guide/ as the base and the final product home.
intent.objective: Author and validate a governed research-and-authoring route that turns the full Arcanum knowledge surface into a single leverage-oriented manual via x-ray exploration, source-backed inventory, distillation, whisper composition, and source validation.
intent.operator_sentence: X-ray the whole of Arcanum, inventory it source-backed, distill it for each kind of user, whisper it into a manual modeled on development/user-guide/, then validate every claim against its source.

route_menu.context_hint: Arcanum already ships a User/Translate/Guide development user-guide; this route reuses that surface as the explanatory pattern base and the final home for a broader leverage-oriented manual.

items.label: X-ray, research, distill, whisper a manual
items.description: Explore the full Arcanum surface with x-ray, inventory it source-backed, distill it per audience, author it through whisper, and validate every claim against its source.

items.label: Whisper a manual directly
items.description: Rejected: authoring without a source-backed inventory and distillation would produce an unverifiable manual that drifts from the framework.

items.label: Expand the existing README
items.description: Rejected: the goal is a leverage-oriented, audience-aware manual, not an enlarged top-level README.

technique_overlays.trigger: The manual must cover the entire Arcanum surface, not one capability.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: X-ray output is a navigable layered map of framework, method, disciplines, sigils, spells, and observability with concrete source paths for each node.

technique_overlays.trigger: Manual claims must be source-backed, not invented; the corpus must separate canonical from candidate knowledge.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Every knowledge unit carries a source path and a canonical/candidate status, and unverifiable claims are recorded as residue rather than asserted.

technique_overlays.trigger: The brief requires explaining how each kind of user can leverage Arcanum.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Distilled concept units are grouped by reader leverage (what Arcanum is, its processes, and how each user role uses it) and recompose into one coherent manual.

technique_overlays.trigger: Final text is authored by whisper and must follow the development/user-guide pattern.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The manual reads as governed prose modeled on development/user-guide/, and passes source validation before it is treated as done.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The route spans the entire Arcanum surface (framework, method, disciplines, dozens of sigils, spells, observability) and multiple reader audiences, which is wider than one context can x-ray and distill well in a single pass.
subagent_strategy.explanation: After operator approval, fan out read-only explorer lanes by Arcanum layer so the surface is covered in parallel, then a single parent context synthesizes the distilled units and whisper authors the manual. Subagents only gather and distill; they never promote canonical surfaces and never author the final manual independently.
context: Arcanum has a framework/, disciplines/, ~30 sigils under arcana/, ~14 spells under spells/, and an observability model.
development/user-guide/ already demonstrates the target explanatory pattern (User/Translate/Guide).
The brief asks for per-audience leverage, which maps naturally to one explorer/distiller lane per layer plus one synthesizer.

roles.purpose: X-ray and inventory the framework, CyberAlchemy Method, and disciplines.
Inventory the sigil and spell registries and per-capability use/non-use boundaries.
Distill the corpus into per-audience leverage concept units.
roles.owns: Distilled concept units and residue only.

roles.purpose: Verify each manual claim resolves to an Arcanum source path or is recorded as residue.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: This research route can fan out read-only explorer/distiller/validator subagents across Arcanum layers, joined by a single synthesizing parent before whisper authors the manual. Approve subagent execution?
receipt_requirements: Each explorer returns knowledge units with source paths and canonical/candidate status.
The distiller returns concept units grouped by reader leverage plus residue.
The validator returns per-claim source resolution with a pass/flag/block verdict.

steps.name: X-ray the Arcanum framework and capability surface

capability_metadata.projection: Read-only layered exploration of Arcanum; explanatory evidence only.

stop_conditions: Stop if the x-ray map asserts a node that has no concrete Arcanum source path.
Stop if the map flattens framework, sigils, and spells into one undifferentiated list.

steps.name: Inventory the Arcanum knowledge corpus, source-backed

capability_metadata.projection: Compiled source-backed knowledge index; not canonical promotion.

stop_conditions: Stop if a knowledge unit has no source path.
Stop if candidate knowledge is recorded as canonical.

steps.name: Distill the corpus into per-audience leverage concept units
stop_conditions: Stop if a distilled unit cannot recompose into the larger framework it came from.
Stop if no leverage grouping (what / process / per-user use) is produced.

steps.name: Whisper-author the Arcanum manual

capability_metadata.projection: Whisper composition lifecycle authors the manual text; it does not promote canonical surfaces.

stop_conditions: Stop if the draft asserts capabilities or processes not present in the distilled, source-backed units.
Stop if the manual departs from the development/user-guide explanatory pattern without reason.

steps.name: Validate the manual against Arcanum sources

capability_metadata.projection: Answers what is source-backed vs candidate; validation evidence only.

stop_conditions: Stop and flag if any manual claim cannot be resolved to a source path.
Stop if validation evidence is treated as promotion of any sigil, spell, or definition.

gates.condition: Every knowledge unit and manual claim resolves to a concrete Arcanum source path; unverifiable claims become residue, not assertions.
The manual explains what Arcanum is, what its processes are, and how each kind of user can leverage it, with no audience silently dropped.
The final manual is authored through the whisper composition lifecycle and follows the development/user-guide explanatory pattern.
The manual must pass source validation (every claim source-resolved or flagged) before it is treated as done.
Recommended explorer/distiller/validator subagents run only after the operator approves the subagent strategy.

This route only authors a manual and supporting notes under development/user-guide/ and .craft/; it must not promote, mutate, or claim authority over any sigil, spell, definition, registry, or other canonical Arcanum surface.

boundaries.contract: X-ray, inventory, and distill return explanatory, source-pathed evidence only; returning evidence never modifies or grants authority over any canonical sigil, spell, definition, or registry.
Whisper imports distilled, source-backed concept units to author development/user-guide/ARCANUM-MANUAL.md; it asserts nothing beyond the imported units.
Validation returns per-claim source resolution as evidence; the verdict proves source-backing and never grants the manual or its sources canonical authority.

promotion_guardrails: This dispatch authors documentation only; it never modifies or claims authority over sigils, spells, definitions, registries, or other canonical Arcanum surfaces.
x-ray, inventory, and distill outputs are explanatory evidence, not canonical knowledge promotion.
Validation evidence proves the manual is source-backed; it does not grant the manual authority over the sources it explains.
